resources.string: Do these steps once. Only file access is required.
Pick the language of the app and the language you write in by hand. If you change the app language, the app restarts and this page comes back.
%1$s saves your notes as files. It needs your permission for that.
HD or Regal mode gives the sharpest ink on the screen.
Boox tablets can freeze apps in the background to save battery. A frozen app closes, and you can lose work.
1. Press and hold the %1$s icon on the Boox home screen.\n2. Tap \"Unfreeze app\".

• Swipe up/down: Scroll page
• Swipe left/right: Previous/next page
• Pinch with 2 fingers: Zoom
• Tap page number: Quick jump
• Two-finger swipe left/right: Show/hide toolbar

• Hold & drag: Select items
• Double tap: Undo
• Double tap on selection: Copy
• Drag selection: Move
• Scribble to erase (if enabled)

• Tap the page number to jump to a page.
• Turn on scribble-to-erase in Settings to erase like on paper.
• Use the export option on a selection to share it as an image.
• %1$s can show a LaTeX PDF live. See the README.
• You can change every gesture in Settings.
